verdict.rationale: Notte documents live viewing of sessions: a ViewerUrl is returned when a session starts so you can watch the browser live, and the marketing site lists Live View, screenshare and session playback. Nothing in the evidence shows a human taking control of a running agent session; the CDP/Playwright endpoint is a developer building block, not a takeover feature. missing for 10: documented human takeover or intervention mid-run, handoff back to the agent after manual control, independent or hands-on corroboration of the live view.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck

citations.quote: When you start a session, the output includes a `ViewerUrl` - open it to watch your browser live
